replies.author: Sleepnotdeading
replies.body:
Their CEO is on the record saying that they used no generative AI in any aspect of the creative process.  Everything is handcrafted.  They used ML for things like mocap cleaning and code completion, tech which predates LLMs by a good bit.

They had a billion dollar budget to staff up the best devs in the industry.

No, I don’t think they used AI outside of what they publicly declared.  A game that size in development for 8 years doesn’t overhaul its pipeline in the last two in order to leverage emergent technology.
